1268 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1268 mod 100 ≠ 0 or mod 400 = 0).  
Days in months before September 1268: Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31.  
From 09-25 back 141 days:  
First go back 25 days to Sep 1 → 25 days subtracted, 116 left.  
Back through August (31 days) → 85 left.  
Back through July (31 days) → 54 left.  
Back through June (30 days) → 24 left.  
Back through May (31 days) → would overshoot, so stop at May.  
May has 31 days, so 24 days before May 31 is May 7.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1268-05-07
